title: OpenBrain Hook Payload
description: The JSON object a host CLI writes to the standard input of `open-brain hook <event>`. Every field is optional: the payload is written by another program, and a hook that requires a field is a hook that breaks a session when the host changes. Unknown fields are ignored, never rejected.

cwd.description: Working directory of the host. The primary signal used to locate the vault, and the only one both hosts provide.

hook_event_name.description: Host name of the event that fired.

transcript_path.description: Absolute path to the session transcript. Open Brain reads it only when the transcripts capability is armed for a directory that contains it.

permission_mode.description: Permission mode of the host. In plan mode every hook that could write, warn, or refuse stays inert.

prompt.description: UserPromptSubmit only. The raw text the user submitted.

source.description: SessionStart only. Why the session started.

tool_name.description: PreToolUse and PostToolUse. Write, Edit, Bash, Read on Claude Code; apply_patch, exec, exec_command on Codex.

tool_input.description: PreToolUse and PostToolUse. Arguments of the tool call. Its shape depends on the tool.

file_path.description: Write and Edit. Target file. `path` is accepted as a fallback.

new_string.description: Edit. The added text. old_string is never read.

command.description: Bash, exec, exec_command, and apply_patch. A shell command as a single string, or, on Codex, an argument vector. Both forms are normalized to one string.

patch.description: apply_patch. The textual patch, when it is not passed as the command.

tool_response.description: PostToolUse only. Result of the tool call.

stop_hook_active.description: Stop only. True when the assistant is already continuing because of an earlier stop block. The stop hook never blocks again while this is true, because that is how a hook becomes an infinite loop.

trigger.description: PreCompact only. Whether compaction was automatic or asked for.

turn_id.description: Codex only. Identifier of the current turn, and therefore the harness discriminant: Claude Code never sends it. A payload carrying a non-empty turn_id of at most 256 characters with no space is treated as a Codex payload.

model.description: Identifier of the model. Present on some hosts, read by nothing.
